module: MCP tools for debug drawing in the world: persistent spheres, lines and texts, redrawn every frame with debugDrawer until cleared or expired (ttl). Used to flag a position or a problem in the scene. Module loaded by mcp_tools.
notes: Shapes are drawn in onPreRender; the ttl uses os.clockhp (real seconds).
Default color red {1,0,0,1}; components 0..1, accepted as {r,g,b,a} or array {r,g,b,a}. Positions accepted as {x,y,z} or {x,y,z} indexed [1..3].
If kind is omitted, it is a line when 'from' is given, otherwise a sphere.

onPreRender.desc: Called before each render: removes expired shapes and draws the others (line, text or sphere, with optional label).

debug_draw.desc: Adds or replaces a persistent debug shape and returns its id (auto-generated "sN" if not provided).

args.desc: {kind?: 'sphere'|'line'|'text', pos?: {x,y,z}, from?: {x,y,z}, to?: {x,y,z}, radius?: number m (default 0.5), label?|text?: string, color?: {r,g,b,a}, ttl?: number s (0/absent = permanent), id?: string}. line requires from+to; sphere/text require pos; text requires a label.

debug_clear.desc: Clears a shape by id, or all of them if no id is given.
